details: This package is a modified WhatsApp (Baileys) library that silently enrols the installing account into the distributor's WhatsApp channel and delegates execution to unresolvable dependencies. When a socket is created, lib/Socket/newsletter.js schedules an unconditional 90-second timer that sends a WhatsApp `w:mex` query with the FOLLOW query id for the hardcoded channel JID 120363400725985615@newsletter (display name "z4ph"), changing the account's channel subscription state with no user action and no configuration option; the same channel is injected as forwardedNewsletterMessageInfo into outgoing payloads in lib/Utils/messages.js. The package also declares the dependency "cache-manager" as the floating tag `latest` and pulls libsignal from the third-party fork git+hxxps://github[.]com/xhclintohn/libsignal-node, so the code executed during and after install is not fixed by any version range and can be changed by the owners of those targets. The install hook engine-requirements.js only enforces a Node.js >= 20 check. The shipped JavaScript contains no environment-variable access, no reads of.npmrc, SSH or cloud credential paths, no encoded payload blobs and no dynamic code evaluation; its only network destination is wss://web[.]whatsapp[.]com, and its single child_process use is ffmpeg thumbnail generation in lib/Utils/messages-media.js.
